device: Steam Deck OLED internal SSD replacement

requirements.requirement: LCD versus OLED model identification and compatible storage
physical replacement access and ESD precautions

work_steps.instruction: Record the current symptom, OS behavior, free space, SMART or equivalent health output, filesystem checks, and any error messages without assuming the SSD is the cause.
Confirm OLED identity and document the current SSD model, capacity, interface information, and visible physical configuration if safely accessible.
Back up required files and configuration data while the current drive remains readable; verify the backup by opening representative files and recording what was included.
Prepare the recovery/install path and document account, encryption, game-library, and application restoration requirements before removing the original drive.
Power down fully, disconnect external power, establish ESD controls, and follow a device-specific OLED disassembly procedure. Do not proceed if the procedure or tool fit is uncertain.
Access the SSD without stressing cables, shields, connectors, or the battery assembly; preserve the original SSD and hardware for diagnosis or recovery.
Install only a candidate that has independently verified M.2 2230 single-sided fit and Steam Deck OLED electrical/software compatibility. No exact replacement is authorized by the supplied evidence.
Reassemble with correct shielding, fasteners, connector seating, and no pinched cables, then perform a visual inspection before power-up.
Confirm drive detection in the available firmware or recovery environment.
Install or recover SteamOS using the selected authoritative recovery procedure, then restore backed-up data and reconfigure libraries or accounts as applicable.
Run the validation gates and record results; if any required gate fails, stop and diagnose rather than treating the SSD replacement as the solution.

critical_unknowns.description: The current SSD health, SMART status, filesystem state, boot status, and exact failure symptoms are unknown.
Backup status, backup completeness, backup readability, and recovery objectives are unknown.
The exact Steam Deck OLED model identifier and hardware revision have not been independently documented.
The current SSD model and its interface details are unknown.
No exact replacement SSD has been proposed, so interface support, capacity support, firmware behavior, thermal behavior, endurance, and physical clearance remain unverified.
The required recovery-image version, installation method, encryption state, and restore procedure are unspecified.
The user's required data set, acceptable downtime, and tolerance for reinstallation or data loss are unspecified.
Disassembly tool availability, ESD controls, workspace conditions, and operator experience are unknown.
There is no supplied bench evidence, measured diagnostic output, or post-repair test result.

The supplied ifixit_deck_oled_ssd claims establish OLED M.2 2230 single-sided storage, additional recovery or installation work, and ESD precautions, but do not establish compatibility of any particular replacement part or that replacement will resolve the issue.

acceptance_gates.criterion: Do not substitute LCD-specific guide without model review
Do not claim replacement fixes unmeasured issue
No data preservation guarantee without backup

required_parts.requirement: Device-specific requirement: Steam Deck OLED must be confirmed before work; the supplied task explicitly prohibits substituting an LCD-specific guide without model review.
Storage requirement sourced from ifixit_deck_oled_ssd: Steam Deck OLED SSD is M.2 2230 and single-sided.

The replacement must also have an interface, keying, electrical characteristics, controller behavior, thermal envelope, and capacity supported by the Steam Deck OLED and intended operating-system workflow; exact compatibility is unverified from the supplied claims.
Use an appropriate external backup destination with enough capacity for the selected data; destination type and capacity are not supplied.
Use a SteamOS-compatible recovery or installation medium and a recovery image obtained from an authoritative source; exact image version and procedure are not supplied.
Use ESD-control equipment and suitable non-damaging disassembly tools. The supplied ifixit_deck_oled_ssd claim requires following ESD precautions.
Do not select a replacement SSD, enclosure, adapter, screw, thermal interface, or recovery medium as an exact part until compatibility and physical fit are verified.
Approximate cost categories, not sourced facts: replacement SSD, backup/recovery media, ESD and hand tools, and possible professional data recovery or repair labor.
